Hello, you've reached Sakura Say-koh-tsoo-in. This is the clinic's AI receptionist, speaking in English. How can I help you today?
Could you put me through to a staff member?
I can't transfer calls, but I can take your details so a staff member can call you back. May I ask what your call is regarding?
I'm sorry, I didn't quite catch that. Could you say it again, please?
I have something I want to talk about.
Sure, I can help with that. Can you tell me a bit more about what you want to discuss?
Thank you. It sounds like your name is Yada. Could you please give me the rest of your name?
Thank you, Shoji. Just to confirm, your full name is Shoji Yada. Is that correct?
